run_eval: run the evaluation comparing test output JSON against ground truth JSON for depth and normal metrics
calc_depth_distance_scale_invariant: calculate the scale-invariant depth distance between predicted and ground truth depth maps using a foreground mask
calc_normal_distance: calculate the cosine distance between predicted and ground truth surface normal maps using a foreground mask
erode_mask: erode a binary mask with a 5x5 kernel and optionally resize it to a target square size
review_eval: review the eval module functions for depth and normal evaluation metrics on egocentric scene data
